subject: snowy sheathbill
title: Antarctica Has One Land Bird, and It Lives by Robbing Penguins

scenes.text: Antarctica has one land bird, and it survives by robbing penguins.
The snowy sheathbill has no webbed feet. It can't hunt at sea like everything around it.
So it waits beside penguin parents while they feed their chicks.
Right as the krill passes from beak to beak, it flies at them. The meal spills, and it grabs it.
It also eats penguin eggs, weak chicks, seal leftovers, and even droppings.
On a continent of ice, the only land bird found one job: thief.

description:
The snowy sheathbill is the only land bird native to the Antarctic continent. Without webbed feet it cannot feed at sea, so it scavenges in penguin and seal colonies.
It harasses penguins as they pass krill to their chicks so the food is dropped, and also eats eggs, dead chicks, carcasses and droppings.
Would you call it a thief or a survivor?
first_comment: Sailors used to call it the 'paddy'. Do penguins have any defence against a bird like this?
